name: brickmotion-native-electron-ui
description: Complete Electron desktop interface for BrickMotion Studio powered by the native C++/Metal engine with full web UI parity

scripts.build: npm run build:addon && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && npm run dev:electron"
